situations.headline: Selectis Health taken private by Black Pearl Equities via merger closing Sept 4, 2026

changelog.entry: stage-2 assessment: Selectis Health taken private by Black Pearl Equities via merger closing Sept 4, 2026 (interest 3, risk 6)

thesis.text: Selectis Health has been acquired and taken private by Black Pearl Equities II LLC via a merger that closed September 4, 2026, with financing from Milrose Capital and SCG Experts Corp secured against the surviving entity's real estate portfolio [us:0001493152-26-041840 ex10-1.htm]. Post-close, control rests with Abraham Schwartz and Schneur Zalman Schapiro through a layered holding structure [us:0001493152-26-041840 ex10-1.htm]. With no disclosed per-share consideration or public float remaining, there is no evident public-market arbitrage; the file should be watched only for residual appraisal-rights or SEC deregistration filings.
